meta.name: Recipe: Peak-Hold Meter
meta.description: A VU-style level meter with asymmetric smoothing: instant attack, slow release. The var formula if(low > hold, low, hold * 0.96) snaps the held value straight up to a louder low band, then eases it back down by a fixed factor each frame when the band falls — so the meter leaps to peaks and decays gracefully. A row of segment lights fills up to the held level via step(threshold, hold). Luminance is energy-gated so the panel is calm in silence; the beat is never wired to a color channel.
